info.title: Librarium API
info.description: Backend of the Little Dragon online library. Errors use the shape `{error: {code, message, details}}`.

post.description: After 10 failed attempts for one email address within 15 minutes, further attempts are refused with 429 until the window has passed.
Rotates the refresh cookie and returns a new access token. Re-using an already rotated refresh token revokes the whole token family.
Changes the password, signs out all other sessions and issues new tokens.
Emails a password reset link if an active account uses this address. The answer is the same either way, so it does not reveal which addresses are registered.
Sets a new password with the token from the reset email and signs the account out everywhere. Fails with INVALID_RESET_TOKEN for expired or used links.

delete.description: Deletes the account after checking the password: personal data is removed, orders stay for the library's records without the reader's name or contacts. 409 ACTIVE_ORDERS while books are requested or on loan; 409 ADMIN_ACCOUNT for administrators.

post.description: Idempotent: adding a book that is already in the cart changes nothing. Returns 409 BOOK_UNAVAILABLE when the copy is reserved or not available.

Places an order for every complete batch in the cart. Books of an incomplete trailing batch stay in the cart. Prices are computed by the server. Responds 409 BOOK_UNAVAILABLE (details.book_ids) when any copy is no longer available; in that case nothing is created.

Extends a borrowed order's due date by one loan period. Allowed up to max_renewals times (GET /library/rules) and not once the books are overdue; otherwise 409 RENEWAL_NOT_ALLOWED with details.reason not_borrowed | overdue | limit_reached | requested_by_others (another reader is waiting for one of the books).

get.description: Batch size and price, loan period and how often a loan can be extended.

post.description: Email me when this book is available again. Idempotent: 201 when added, 200 when already waiting. 409 BOOK_AVAILABLE if the book can be ordered right now.

get.description: "Want to read": one entry per title, newest first, each with the copy that can be borrowed now if there is one.

post.description: Creates books from CSV text (header row; required columns title, author, category). All or nothing: with any invalid row nothing is created and `errors` lists them by line. `dry_run=true` only validates. At most 500 books per import.

Title, author and description of a book in another interface language, for the librarian to review: the official name of the work from Wikidata (found by the ISBN's Open Library work), the Wikipedia summary (keep source_url for attribution), and machine translation of what is still missing when it is set up (machine_available). Saves nothing.

get.description: Title, author, description, year, language, cover, series and suggested tags for an ISBN, from Open Library. 404 ISBN_NOT_FOUND, 502 LOOKUP_UNAVAILABLE.

post.description: Adds copies of a title (same catalogue data, status available). The catalogue lists the title once and counts its copies.

schema.title: Response Admin Add Copies Api V1 Admin Books  Book Id  Copies Post

delete.description: Soft delete: the book disappears from the catalogue and from carts, while existing orders keep referencing it.

patch.description: Allowed transitions: pending → confirmed | cancelled, confirmed → returned. Returned and cancelled orders release their books.

post.description: Emails the customer a reminder (overdue, or due soon) with the next notifier run. Only for borrowed orders, at most once per 24 hours (409 REMINDER_RECENTLY_SENT).

delete.description: The tag disappears from every book.

post.description: Books with this tag get the tag `into_id` instead; this tag is deleted.

delete.description: Deletes the series; its books stay in the catalogue without a series.

post.description: Moves the books to the series `into_id` (keeping their volume numbers) and deletes this series.

get.description: Orders placed, loans (orders handed over) and their books, returns, revenue (orders handed over), readers and the 10 most borrowed books in the period; overdue loans right now. Default period: the last 30 days.

What readers want: the titles with the most readers waiting and the most "want to read" saves (right now, with the number of copies), and the tags of the books lent in the period. Default period: the last 30 days.
Orders placed in the period as CSV (UTF-8 with BOM for spreadsheet apps).
